'''C'bal''' was an independent [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who once witnessed a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crimelord]] assassinating a rival by telling rigging an [[EG-6 power droid/Legends|EG-6 power droid]] with [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]]. Thee droid walked off the catwalk, falling fifteen stories onto a rival crime lord's [[floater]].
